shared_elements: long fringed/pleated robe reaching the ankles
raised arm carrying or holding an object
curled/patterned hair and beard rendered as regular ordered rows
low relief with figures on a single ground line
hands and feet shown in profile with detailed toes/nails
justification: Both depict robed, profile human-bodied figures in low relief with strongly stylized, regularly patterned hair/beard and drapery, arms raised holding objects, accompanied by rosette/floral motifs, and both use the same conventions of ordered curl rows and anatomically detailed profile feet. The biggest differences in content are the number and organization — A is a repeating file of many identical human attendants processing along a band above a rosette frieze, while B is a single large bird-headed winged figure isolated beside a stylized plant, with no procession and no human head or wings in A.}
